Real stack (qa-stack.sh, SYNTHETIC seed), independent spec dg1-r2-web-repairs.spec.ts, EN and AR. dev.lead (TL at business_unit SYN-RETAIL only) creates an end-to-end transformation in SYN-RETAIL. The browser lands on /transformations/{id}, the h1 shows the name, there is no 'Not found'/'غير موجود' and no createdNotVisible notice, and the page is still reachable after a reload. GET /api/v1/transformations/{id} returns 200 and the lead can edit it (status draft -> active saved). The derived assignment (F-DG1-106) is shown in the audit trail. A user without grants (dev.nobody) gets 404 for the same record, so no cross-scope leak. Screenshots: web-repairs/chromium-{en,ar}--01-lead-after-create.png. Not exercised end-to-end: the createdNotVisible explanation for a creator who truly cannot see the record (covered only by unit tests in transformations.test.tsx).

Partly fixed. The transformation's own audit events are now localized in AR and EN: the field labels status, mode, phase, code, name, time zone, currency and business unit, and the values draft/active, end-to-end and diagnose, with the business unit shown by name instead of a UUID. No raw snake_case keys appear for them. But on exactly the F-DG1-004 path (a BU-scoped lead creates a record), the same 'Changes' column also shows the derived-assignment event added by F-DG1-106 in this round. It renders unlocalized in both languages. The action column shows the raw code 'scoped_assignment.create', and the fields show raw camelCase keys (scope, userId, roleCode, effectiveTo, derivedFromAssignmentId), each marked 'field without a translation' / 'حقل بلا ترجمة'. The values are raw JSON ({"id":...,"type":"transformation"}), raw UUIDs and the role code 'TL', marked 'value without a translation'. This is the defect the finding describes (raw keys and codes inside the Arabic RTL and English layouts) for an event that every BU-lead-created record now carries. The marked fallback is honest, but it is not the localized label the fix promises for domain values. Expected: localized action, field and role labels (and a user/scope display) for scoped_assignment.* events shown in a transformation's audit trail, or the event filtered or summarized in human terms. Reproduction: 17-web-repairs.log, soft assertions at dg1-r2-web-repairs.spec.ts:132-138 fail in EN and AR while every other assertion passes. Screenshots: web-repairs/chromium-{ar,en}--03-audit-trail-localized.png.
